versions.changelog: Marketplace metadata revision only: source binds the public OwlRunKit engine repository and homepage points to the unified OwlCoda product site. Core remains owlrunkit@0.23.0; no capability or runtime change.

- Bumped bundled Core to owlrunkit@0.23.0 (Contract 0.2); updated all references and integrity hashes.
- Project homepage updated in metadata to new URL.
- Added explicit licensing information: Skill package is MIT-0; invoked CLI is GPL-3.0-or-later. LICENSE file now included.
- Minor clarifications and removal of outdated version references in SKILL.md.
- New OpenAI agent configuration file added; old skill-card documentation removed.

- Version 0.22.1 introduces updates to the bundled deterministic Core (`0.22.1`) and Contract (`0.2`) artifacts, with updated manifest integrity.
- The skill provides a comprehensive CLI for coordinating complex, receipt-backed multi-agent projects, supporting Team Delivery Phase 1 and 2 workflows, artifact-based session management, project lifecycle actions, and strong evidence capture.
- Explicit documentation on use cases such as agent handoff, deferred verification, foreign project shadowing, recovery, and reproducible receipt-based restoration.
- Clarifies registry adoption, fail-closed installation policy, rollback baseline, and lack of widened authority over Git/release.
- Reinforces strict boundaries: CLI/Skill cannot manage global dependencies, installation, or mutable project state outside tightly governed evidence/accountability flows.
